info.title: AgentFlow API
info.description: REST API for the AgentFlow durable workflow platform. Endpoints are served under {@code /api/v1}; the tenant is taken only from the verified security context, never from the request body.

bearerAuth.description: OIDC access token from Keycloak, sent as {@code Authorization: Bearer <token>} (issuer and audience established by the OIDC resource server in S04).
